description: Async. Batch-add competitor domains (1–20) to the brand. Returns { operationId, status } — poll get_job until state=completed. Each domain triggers crawl + profile analysis. Rows added by other paths (probe-classify, SEO competitors, cluster approval) stay analysisState "pending" until competitor_analyze; 50 credits each unless the free slot is unused, subscription required after that. Typically takes ~2–5 min.

domains.description: One to twenty competitor domains to add (e.g. ['acme.com', 'rival.io']).

name: competitor_add
